_doc: Task 53 shops (scripts/systems/shop_acts.gd). The pawn can take anything off a shelf (objects.<def>.goods) without paying, slip it into a pocket (SkillCheck shoplift, watched by staff and shoppers), or eat it in the aisle. Task 63: a counter order (orders: the real interaction) is paid when ordered (short of coins: the cashier says how much). Only an order marked tab (a round at the bar) or any order on a tab_venues lot runs a tab, paid at the till like goods; an unnoticed walk-out on a tab is one line to the player, never a shoplifting case. Paying happens at the till (till_objects on a shop lot); with too little cash the cashier says how much is missing. Walking out with unpaid goods: a cashier on shift (cashier_roles) who is there notices by their own attention (watch, less when busy: busy_per_customer per shopper in the shop, perception helps) and asks; concealed goods are only seen if the pocketing was spotted or the concealment check fails. Not noticed: the goods are yours, and the theft may still be found (CrimePetty shoplifting). replaces: the old pay-at-the-shelf interactions the pawn no longer gets (NPCs keep them).

till._doc: The till (scripts/systems/till_acts.gd): float + per_hour of opening (times a stable 0.5..1.5) while open; empty after closing or once taken today. staff_sees: chance the staff at the post sees you open it.

caught: "Hey! Get away from the till!" {n} snaps.
{n} slams a hand on the drawer. "What do you think you're doing?"
back_off: You step back. {n} watches you closely.
{n} shuts the drawer and keeps an eye on you.
lie_ok: "Ask next time," {n} says, and lets it go.
lie_fail: "Change, my foot," says {n}, reaching for the phone.
empty: The drawer slides open. It's empty.
Nothing in it but a few receipts.

ask: "Are you going to pay for that?" {n} calls from the till.
{n} looks up. "Excuse me, you haven't paid for that."
ask_tab: "Excuse me! You haven't paid!" {n} calls across the room.
{n} catches you at the door. "Settling up before you go?"
short: {n} counts it. "{t} altogether. You're {s} coins short."
lie_fail: "No, you didn't," says {n}, reaching for the phone.
shout: "Hey! Come back here!" {n} shouts after you.
{n} shouts something at your back as the door swings shut.
put_back: You put it back on the shelf.
You leave it on the counter.
eat: You eat it right there in the aisle.
You tear it open and eat it on the spot.
